model_annotations.English: Figure 4, titled "Hicder State Mean," is a line plot that compares the mean absolute values of hidden states before and after a gating mechanism. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, representing the different layers of a model. The y-axis, labeled "Abs. Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 in increments of 1. The plot displays three distinct lines: a solid green line representing the "Hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," a dashed green line for the "Hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and a solid blue line for the "Hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The solid green line starts at a value of approximately 0.05 at layer 0 and increases steadily, reaching a value of approximately 4.0 at layer 25. The dashed green line begins at a value of approximately 0.05 at layer 0 and remains relatively flat, staying just above the baseline until layer 20, after which it rises sharply to a value of approximately 4.0 at layer 25. The solid blue line, representing the baseline, remains flat at a value of approximately 0.04 across all layers. The legend indicates that the values for the baseline and post-gating values are similar.
